pageProps.title: A Murder is Announced
pageProps.review: Discover the truth and interesting impressions of Agatha Christie's mystery novel A Murder is Announced, where Miss Marple investigates a unique premise of announcing a murder via a newspaper advertisement.
pageProps.description: A murder is announced. Friday, October 29th, at 6:30 PM. Place: Little Paddocks. Those who are interested are welcome.
pageProps.content:
## Review The setting of announcing a murder through a newspaper advertisement is original. > “A murder is announced. Friday, October 29th, at 6:30 PM. Place: Little Paddocks. Those who are interested are welcome.” The residents think this advertisement is either a play or a joke, and some come to the Little Paddocks mansion out of curiosity. The owner of the mansion is flustered but welcomes the guests, and when the set time arrives, a sudden power outage occurs.
At that moment, a gunshot rings out, and an intruder enters but is shot dead on the spot.
The play seemed to end as an attempted murder by the intruder, but a new truth is revealed by ```Miss Marple```.
The family tree was complicated, so it was a bit difficult, but I read it with interest because the setting was unique.
